== Description ==
Original Japanese [[M-HYD 'Binary' Droid (Japanese)|M-HYD 'Binary' Droid]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

== Source and credit ==
Photograph of the physical card from the SWCCG Cards shop listing ''M-HYD 'Binary' Droid (Japanese)'', <code>https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ls-m-hyd-binary-droid/</code> (now returns Page not found).
